verdict.rationale: Raygun documents native repo integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab, and uses source maps to show readable code snippets from source. That covers the repo-connection part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows suspect commits, code owners, or linking a stack frame to the exact line on the default branch. Missing for 10: suspect-commit attribution, code-owner display, stack-frame-to-source-line linking on the default branch, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform connects to my repos so an issue shows suspect commits and code owners, and I can jump from a stack frame to the exact line on my default branch

citations.quote: Connect to your repo through native integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab, with support for source map decoding.
translate them to be readable and to include code snippets from your source
